title: Iota
body:
This mod has been archived due to being *extremely* outdated.

![Available for NeoForge](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d0ffe96f9766e9c55ff4ea4ac4670b4dad1b13ef.png)
# Iota
**Please note: there are NO CONFIGS RIGHT NOW.**

Iota attempts to be a modular mod like Quark, but will add a lot more big features like bosses, reworks of existing mechanics, and more.

Currently, there's only Withered Potatoes, a Void block, and an InfiniCharge (infinite wind charge), but as this mod lives, its features will grow.

## FAQ
Q: Fabric/Quilt support?

A: No.

Q: Can you port to version 1.x.x?

A: No*

*I will likely port to the latest major update, but don't expect a version for every single minor update that Mojang likes to put out. Also, no backports.
